title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: EMPOWER!-Enabling Meaningful Participation of Women and girls for Essential Rights- has the goal of protecting and empowering the most vulnerable women and girls in Melut, Upper Nile, South Sudan. EMPOWER aims to raise awareness and shift behaviours on education, gender equality, protection, and GBV. Addressing GBV through prevention, response and referral pathways is a core element of the programme; in addition to overcoming the barriers to girls’ education, providing safe, gender sensitive learning environments with quality teaching. The project will reach 33,261 women, men, girls and boys in 2023 with education and protection services.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Improved protection services and empowerment opportunities for the most vulnerable women and girls. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The EMPOWER! programme is supporting the social and economic empowerment and provision of protection services for the most vulnerable women and girls in Upper Nile state, South Sudan. The programme is increasing the knowledge awareness and capacity of communities to address gender norms and practices affecting women and girls, improving access to appropriate quality psycho-social support and response services for at risk women, girls and boys and providing economic opportunities for vulnerable women.
